summary: Bumthang district is dominated by forest cover, comprising 1278.02 km² or 47.1 % of its area, followed by Alpine Scrubs at 524.32 km² (19.3 %). The landscape is largely mountainous, with Rocky Outcrops covering 283.13 km² (10.4 %) and Snow and Glacier areas totaling 231.24 km² (8.5 %). Agricultural land is minimal, occupying only 41.63 km² or 1.5 % of the district.
